text: What if you grew ten times bigger... every five seconds?
One point eight meters. Normal you. Coffee in hand.
Eighteen meters. You're waving at your neighbor... on the fifth floor.
A hundred and eighty. Taller than most skyscrapers.
One point eight kilometers. Stub your toe now, and you'll feel it in fifteen seconds.
Eighteen kilometers. Passenger jets fly past your belly button.
A hundred and eighty kilometers. Your head is officially in space.
Eighteen hundred. One shoe covers an entire city.
Eighteen thousand. You're now taller than the Earth is wide.
And that toe you stubbed? You'll feel it... in almost two days.
Follow for part two. You shrink.
